CustomField.formula:
IF( AND( Broken_Shift__c, (BLANKVALUE(Actual_Duration__c,0) + BLANKVALUE(Broken_Extended_Duration__c,0)) > 0 ),
( (BLANKVALUE(Actual_Duration__c,0) * BLANKVALUE(Staff_Hourly_Rate__c,0))
+
(BLANKVALUE(Broken_Extended_Duration__c,0) * BLANKVALUE(Broken_Extended_Rate__c,0))
+
BLANKVALUE(Broken_Shift_Allowance__c,0) )
/
(BLANKVALUE(Actual_Duration__c,0) + BLANKVALUE(Broken_Extended_Duration__c,0)),
0 )
CustomField.label: Broken Rate Per Hrs
